name: toggle
title: Toggle
description: One on/off button (Base UI Toggle, aria-pressed): pressed floods yellow and fills the lamp; icon toggles show a floor keyline. Control or cell, alone or as a cell of a field frame. ToggleGroup composes its cells.
whenToUse: Use it for a button that stays pressed, such as Bold or Pin. For a setting in a form use Switch or Checkbox; for a command use Button.

parts.name: Toggle
parts.description: Toggle: one on/off button on Base UI Toggle (`aria-pressed`). Pressed FLOODS yellow from the press point (the working set) and fills the lamp, so the state has a shape as well as a colour; the label never changes with the state. Controlled (`pressed` + `onPressedChange`) or uncontrolled (`defaultPressed`). For several related toggles use ToggleGroup; for one of many use Segmented.

props.name: count
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon only: a square cell; pass `aria-label`. Pressed shows a floor keyline instead of the lamp.

props.name: layout
props.description: control: its own frame. cell: a cell of an enclosing frame (a panel header, a field frame).
